1|<!-- AGENTS.md — Codex-LOOP-Build-F2 discipline section (~100 lines).
   2|     This file is a BYTE-STABLE PREFIX: it is loaded at the start of every
   3|     session and must not change between runs of the same package version,
   4|     so prompt caching stays effective. Do not append run-specific content,
   5|     timestamps, or state here — state lives on disk under data/. -->
   6|
   7|# LOOP Discipline
   8|
   9|## 1. Decomposition discipline (single-pass Plan-and-Solve)
  10|
  11|- Planning is a SINGLE PASS: read the task, then emit the complete decomposition
  12|  in one planning event — `packets/*.json` (exactly 4 fields: `goal`,
  13|  `authorized_paths`, `acceptance`, `constraints`, plus `packet_id`) and `dag.json`.
  14|- No incremental re-planning mid-wave. Plans change only at an adjudication
  15|  event (dead-letter, merge conflict, L3 escalation, wave finale).
  16|- Each packet must be self-contained: an Executor with only the 4 fields and its
  17|  worktree can finish it. If a packet needs "context from the main thread", the
  18|  decomposition is wrong — split or rewrite it.
  19|- Intra-wave packets must have non-intersecting `authorized_paths`; the DAG
  20|  assertion enforces this before any dispatch.
  21|- No 5th required packet field. No idempotency_key, no embedded runtime_resources.
  22|
  23|## 2. Anti-polling negative discipline (what Sol rounds are NOT for)
  24|
  25|Sol is invoked on exactly two event types: **planning** and **adjudication**.
  26|Sol rounds are NEVER used for:
  27|
  28|- **Waiting** — native wait-all blocks without producing rounds.
  29|- **Polling** — status lives in `data/events.ndjson`; scripts consume it.
  30|- **Tallying** — report counting is the missing-item check script's job.
  31|- **Retry decisions** — `config/retry_classes.yaml` + retry script decide.
  32|- **State recap** — the state machine holds state; never ask Sol "where were we".
  33|
  34|Any transition decidable by if/else, exit code, or a state machine does not go
  35|through an LLM. Sol's ideal round count per task approaches **2 + anomaly count**
  36|(one planning round, one finale round, plus one per genuine anomaly). If a run
  37|uses more, find which of the five forbidden uses leaked back in.
  38|
  39|## 3. Return convention (all subagents, mandatory)
  40|
  41|- **Success:** exactly 1 line of conclusion + the artifact path(s).
  42|- **Failure:** 1-line conclusion + the last 50 lines of the failing log + the
  43|  report file path.
  44|- Full logs, test output, and exploration notes go to `reports/<packet_id>/`
  45|  on disk — never into the reply body. Self-reported PASS carries zero weight;
  46|  mechanical acceptance replays the commands independently.
  47|
  48|## 4. Recoverable compression directive
  49|
  50|- Files are the single source of truth; bytes do not reside in Sol context.
  51|- When compressing or compacting: **delete content, keep paths.** A path plus a
  52|  ≤500-token structured summary is always recoverable; inlined content is not.
  53|- Every compaction summary MUST carry: (a) the report index (every report path
  54|  produced so far) and (b) a read/unread checklist so nothing is silently
  55|  dropped. A compaction that loses a path is a defect.
  56|- To re-read detail, use path handles: `head`/`sed` to locate the exact lines,
  57|  never re-ingest whole files.
  58|
  59|## 5. Kernel trigger rules (ipybox, when enabled)
  60|
  61|Route work to the ipybox persistent kernel when either holds:
  62|
  63|- A step will produce **>5,000 tokens of output** — digest it in-process and
  64|  return a variable-name handle plus truncated stdout (≤50 lines printed).
  65|- State must **survive across calls** (dataframes, parsed indexes, counters) —
  66|  kernel state is compression-immune and lives off-heap from the context.
  67|
  68|Otherwise stay with plain tools. In this deployed F2 environment every root and
  69|headless worker can see ipybox, but its Jupyter gateway and IPython kernel start
  70|lazily on the first kernel tool call. Workers that never use it pay no Jupyter
  71|process cost. Kernel discipline: print ≤50 lines, return handles.
  72|

  74|
  75|- **Homogeneous batch** (same instruction over many rows: per-file review,

  86|- Desktop host slots remain capped by
  87|  `agents.max_concurrent_threads_per_session` (50) per root session, while

  89|  dialogue sustains 20 agents. The preferred mixed load is execution=60 and

  91|  pool has no ready work, the other may use all 80 slots.
  92|- Wide execution normally uses WSL/headless `codex exec` workers so Desktop is
  93|  a light control and observation plane. Existing Desktop/CSV entry points stay
  94|  available; routing to headless is a low-friction default, not a global ban.
  95|- Ad-hoc headless waves use `harness/headless_wave.py` so each birth is owned by
  96|  `lifecycle_supervisor.py`, appears in `exec_roster.json`, and is visible on
  97|  8765. A raw unregistered `codex exec` process does not satisfy refill debt.
  98|  Only the matching generation stably observed as `running` is effective;
  99|  `starting`, spawn intent, deny messages, stale/lost rows, and Popen success do
 100|  not reduce the 20/80 deficit.
 101|- A one-shot ad-hoc manifest is observable but is not a sustained-concurrency
 102|  backlog. When a parent dialogue must remain near 20, compile 21-80 real,
 103|  bounded read-only packets into `codex-loop-parent-refill/v1` and admit them
 104|  once through `harness/parent_manifest_importer.py` with `target_active=20`.
 105|  The importer wakes the existing refill consumer; do not launch the same
 106|  packets separately through a second wave.
 107|- Never synthesize filler packets to satisfy a number. If the admitted parent
 108|  backlog is exhausted, 8765 must show `parent_backlog_empty` and zero
 109|  spawnable work rather than pretending spare capacity is refill debt.
 110|- Births are submitted at least 1 second apart. No fixed group pause is added
 111|  while healthy; at most eight agents may still be in the initializing handshake
 112|  at once, and every eighth birth performs one lightweight OpenCodex health
 113|  check. A failed check pauses new births for 30 seconds but does not cancel
 114|  already-running work or clear refill demand.
 115|- Sustain the combined target across the task while independent work remains;
 116|  refill completed/failed slots without requiring another user command.
 117|- Depth stays at 1: children never spawn grandchildren.
 118|- After a batch, failed rows are detected from the output CSV `status` /
 119|  `last_error` columns by script — only failed rows are re-dispatched.
 120|
 121|## 7. Power and safety reminders (restated, enforced elsewhere)
 122|
 123|- L1/L2 can only block or escalate; they can never release to publication.
 124|- High-risk classes (path boundary, test-count decrease, credential/CI/
 125|  migration paths) route deterministically to L3+L4; no verdict overrides them.
 126|- Off-table events go to DEAD_LETTER and wake Sol — fail-visible, never silent.
 127|- Release merge is human-triggered. Always.
 128|
 129|## 8. Sol mechanical discipline: no L0 data processing (enforced, not advisory)
 130|
 131|- Sol NEVER performs L0 data processing itself: searching files or the web,
 132|  computing statistics, aggregating logs, bulk-reading files, or running
 133|  tests/counts. Every such step is either zero-token script work (harness/,
 134|  metering/) or a dispatched worker packet — even when doing it inline would
 135|  feel faster. "The main thread just did it quickly" is exactly how Sol share
 136|  breaks its budget.
 137|- **PreToolUse gate (mechanical enforcement):** `hooks/sol_tool_gate.py` is
 138|  registered as a PreToolUse hook. When the LOOP state is not `planning`,
 139|  `adjudication`, or `release_finalize`, root-session shell / search /
 140|  bulk-read / test / statistics tool calls are DENIED with the instruction to
 141|  dispatch an L0/L1 packet instead. Subagents are never gated. The gate fails
 142|  open on an unreadable ledger (with a stderr note) — discipline enforcement
 143|  must not paralyze the session.
 144|- **Token share budget (measured, not aspirational):**
 145|  `metering/model_token_share.py` aggregates Codex's own rollout JSONL into
 146|  Sol/worker/verifier/reviewer/maintenance buckets and computes
 147|  `share_effective = (sol − sol cached input) / (total − cached input)` as the
 148|  primary control metric, per task / per wave / rolling 24h / rolling 7d /
 149|  cumulative. Over 20% → WARNING; over 25% → BLOCK: no new
 150|  non-planning/adjudication Sol work until the share is back under budget.
 151|  Reviewer tokens sit in their own bucket. Historical Sol-model reviewer
 152|  tokens remain part of the Sol KPI; current K3 reviewer tokens do not.
 153|  Install/acceptance runs are maintenance and never enter production KPIs.

# ============================================================================
# orchestration_policy_v2.toml — declaration face = enforcement face
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Purpose : single policy source for routing modes, token bands, hysteresis,
#           budget caps, gate-guard conditions, and model pins. Every key in
#           this file is READ by the code that enforces it (design invariant 2,
#           phase2_architecture_design.md §1.4).
# Readers : harness/l2_consumer.py, harness/layered_gate.py,
#           harness/result_reducer.py, harness/short_result_validator.py,
#           harness/lifecycle_supervisor_v2.py, hooks/sol_tool_gate_v2.py,
#           metering/model_token_share_v2.py
# NOTE    : concurrency numbers live ONLY in refill_policy.toml.
#           loop_config_v2.toml is a compatibility/documentation mirror.
#           (fixes P0-8.3 fifth-authority defect, phase1b §7 item 8).
# ============================================================================

schema = "codex-loop-orchestration-policy/v2"
policy_version = 2
status = "fable-audit-implementation"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Model pins — models are read from HERE, never hardcoded in Python
# Root Sol remains the Desktop frontier model. Ordinary execution uses
# DeepSeek V4 Flash ultra; verification/review remains on Kimi K3 max.
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
[models]
sol_model = "gpt-5.6-sol"
sol_reasoning = "high"

k3_model = "weiwu/aws.claude-sonnet-4.6"
k3_reasoning = "ultra"
k3_context_tokens = 1000000
k3_compaction_tokens = 800000

v4_model = "weiwu/aws.claude-sonnet-4.6"
v4_reasoning = "ultra"
v4_context_tokens = 1000000
v4_compaction_tokens = 800000

# legacy aliases quarantined into their own bucket — NEVER counted as k3
legacy_aliases = ["gpt-5.6-terra", "gpt-5.6-luna", "gpt-5.6"]
# Every selectable ordinary-execution profile remains in the execution bucket
# across temporary provider switches; v4_model alone is the active spawn pin.
execution_aliases = ["weiwu/deepseek-v4-flash", "alibaba-token-plan/glm-5.2"]

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# ipybox — user constraint: do NOT re-enable Desktop ipybox
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
[ipybox]
desktop_native_enabled = false          # Desktop native: ipybox DISABLED
wsl_headless_worker_enabled = true      # WSL/headless worker: explicit enable
k3_planning_verifying_enabled = false   # K3 plan/verify: disabled unless the
k3_code_execution_exception = true      #   task explicitly needs code exec

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Routing — three-mode switch (P0-1 fix, §2.1)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
[routing]
mode = "cold_start"                  # cold_start | shadow | layered
                                        # flip to layered ONLY via layered_gate
rollback_mode = "cold_start"            # gate condition 6: rollback key
trivial_packet_direct_to_v4 = true
plan_expansion_min_packets = 3
plan_expansion_on_cross_platform = true
plan_expansion_on_release_or_audit = true
plan_expansion_when_sol_5h_above = 0.25
send_l2_consumer = "harness/l2_consumer.py"
explicit_high_risk_route = "direct_l3"
verify_sample_rate = 0.10               # deterministic hash sampling (§2.6)

[l2_queue]
dir = "data/l2_queue"                   # relative to LOOP_ROOT, cross-platform
pending_file = "pending.ndjsonl"
l2_max_age_s = 900                      # unclaimed record older -> fail-visible
claim_heartbeat_interval_s = 15
claim_stale_after_s = 120               # no heartbeat for this long -> reapable
claim_max_reclaims = 2                  # after this the record escalates l3
consumer_heartbeat_max_age_s = 300      # gate condition 1 freshness bound

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
[tokens]
metric = "production_effective_tokens"
